note: lp reconstruction: see ctc-golden.json note. `rows`==null means the case is a purpose-built lp (documented inline) rather than the frame-dict recipe.

phoneCases.name: wrong_target_not_green_just_because_alignment_succeeds
phoneCases.description: θ target, confident s (a confusable competitor) observed throughout: alignment succeeds but the status must not be "correct"; closestPhone reports the observed competitor.

phoneCases.name: not_correct_when_blank_only
phoneCases.description: No non-blank evidence at all: status must be "uncertain", never "correct".

phoneCases.name: not_correct_when_ambiguous_split
phoneCases.description: Evenly split between θ and s, neither dominant: status must be "uncertain", never "correct".

phoneCases.name: length_only_difference_is_accepted_quality
phoneCases.description: Target iː realized without the length mark ([i]) is still the same UK vowel quality: correct.

phoneCases.name: dark_l_is_not_a_different_uk_phoneme
phoneCases.description: Target /l/ realized as dark-l [l̴] is an accepted allophone: must not be likelyIncorrect.

phoneCases.name: confusion_gate_flags_confusable_v_w_substitution
phoneCases.description: Target /v/, confident competitor /w/ (a real, confusable L2 substitution present in CONFUSION): likelyIncorrect.

phoneCases.name: confusion_gate_abstains_on_non_confusable_competitor
phoneCases.description: Target /v/, confident competitor token 99 (not in CONFUSION['v']): the raw scorer abstains as "uncertain"/"ambiguousSubstitution" rather than marking it wrong.

phoneCases.name: weak_form_schwa_reduction_never_incorrect
phoneCases.description: Target /ʊ/ (as in weak "you") realized as schwa: an accepted weak-form reduction, never likelyIncorrect.

phoneCases.name: split_affricate_is_one_phone_with_both_emissions
phoneCases.description: /tʃə/ with /tʃ/ realized as separate [t][ʃ] frames: both expanded rows (tʃ, ə) report "correct".

phoneCases.name: k_probability_split_between_accepted_realizations_is_not_an_error
phoneCases.description: Probability mass split ~44/55 between [k] and [kʰ] (both accepted realizations of /k/): correct, even though expectedTokenProbability alone is well under 0.60.

phoneCases.name: k_confident_wrong_competitor_is_not_correct
phoneCases.description: Confident, dominant [ɡ] where /k/ was expected (ɡ/k are a confusable devoicing pair): not correct.

phoneCases.name: missing_glide_cannot_borrow_from_first_vowel
phoneCases.description: Target /eɪ/ with only the [e]/[ẽ] onset present (0.48+0.48) and no [ɪ] offglide at all: not correct.

phoneCases.name: support_floor_default_admits_thin_but_present_evidence
phoneCases.description: A single frame at 0.45 for the target plus 20 near-uniform low-probability competitors clears the default support floor (0.30) given a strong margin: correct, even though expectedProbability < 0.60.

phoneCases.name: support_floor_stricter_threshold_rejects_the_same_evidence
phoneCases.description: The identical evidence as support_floor_default_admits_thin_but_present_evidence, graded with support raised to 0.60: uncertain.

phoneCases.name: assess_phones_rejects_confident_wrong_competitor
phoneCases.description: θ target, confident s throughout (confusable pair): likelyIncorrect.

phoneCases.name: assess_phones_rejects_ambiguous_split_as_uncertain
phoneCases.description: θ target, evenly split θ/s evidence: uncertain.

phoneCases.name: multi_phone_word_grades_every_phone_after_variant_realization
phoneCases.description: "can" realized as [kʰ æ̃ n], "too" realized as [tʰ u]: every phone (including the nasalized /æ/ and the length-less /uː/) grades correct.

coverageCases.name: coverage_zero_when_no_rows
coverageCases.description: No rows at all: every count is 0 and coverage is 0.0 (not a division-by-zero error).
